facts.text: The Red Raider Guarantee covers tuition and mandatory fees up to $11,852 for entering freshmen from Texas families earning $80,000 or less.

sources.title: Red Raider Guarantee | Financial Aid Home | Texas Tech
sources.quote: Must have a family adjusted gross income of $80,000 or less Must have demonstrated financial need Must be enrolled full-time (at least 12 hours) each semester - Fall/Spring only
